reason: Restore full published research context after excessive reduction; preserve substantive prose, machine-readable evidence and original user concept.
scope: All md/rst/bib/tex files from the original snapshot; JSON records except extracted full-publication pages; decision/requirement/source/review CSV metadata; original Word text and uploaded primary materials. Large numerical matrices and binary reports are outside this restoration.
raw_dataset_policy: No Parquet, road graphs, images, PDF or generated DOCX reports are restored. The only DOCX is the original user-provided concept.
limits: This restores published context and re-downloadable uploads. Previously uncommitted local files lost in the runtime restart are not reconstructed by this action.
authority: Latest user request to restore research context supersedes the previous one-current-MD storage simplification.
